description: Blocks image templates missing required brand handles OR substantive SVG visual content.
why: Every image is a contact card in the wild — screenshots, slides, reposts. Missing brand handle or personal site means lost discoverability. Text-only images fail the 'pictures > 1000 words' principle — human attention favors visual pattern recognition over text parsing.

checks.rationale: An SVG with fewer than 5 elements is decoration, not a visual. A co-intelligence network, chart, or diagram requires circles + lines + labels = substantive content.

exit_codes.0: PASS — all required tokens present + substantive SVG found
exit_codes.1: BLOCK — missing required brand token OR no/empty SVG
exit_codes.2: WARN — missing recommended token (from brand-spec.json: required_in_cta / required_in_company_context)

input_schema.html_file: string (required) — absolute path to HTML template
input_schema.brand_spec: string (optional) — absolute path to brand-spec.json override
